chunks: A man asked al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام about a place in which there was dust: should I blow it away when I want to perform sajdah?
So he said: “There is no issue.”

key_terms.السُّجُودَ: sajdah, the act of prostration in salat (prayer)
key_terms.الصَّادِقَ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the one being asked
key_terms.الْمَكَانِ: the place or spot intended for prostration
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to blow dust from the place of sajdah before prostrating in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that there is no problem in blowing dust away from the place of sajdah before prostration. It indicates ease in matters connected to salat (prayer) and the permissibility of preparing the place of prostration in a simple way.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.841 - A man asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) bout a place with dust where he wanted to blow it away before prostrating.
The Imam said: "There is no issue”.
